description.de: Erzeugt kurze Konzeptseiten je Mechanismus aus Codebelegen. Ein KI-Aufruf je Mechanismus, feste Mermaid-Diagramme und deterministisches Gate; concept_only begrenzt den Lauf auf einzelne Seiten. Benötigt dieses Repository.
description.en: Generates concise concept pages per mechanism from code evidence. One AI call per mechanism, fixed Mermaid diagrams and a deterministic gate; concept_only limits the run to single pages. Requires this repository.

author: MySuricates
instructions: Produce evidence-backed documentation in the explicitly given working directory. This is a controlled documentation task; no commits or platform changes. Each call writes only its given draft. Workflow blocks access neither REST nor the DB.

config.command:
set -euo pipefail
python3 {{ concept_root }}/scripts/concepts/pages.py prepare --root {{ concept_root }} --work {{ concept_output }}/{{ workflow_run_id }} --only {{ concept_only }}

The working anchor is the TODO of the calling operator, already set to IN_PROGRESS. Write exactly ONE German concept page on the mechanism {{ concept }}.
First read {{ concept_output }}/{{ workflow_run_id }}/packets/{{ concept }}.txt. The code evidence comes from {{ concept_root }}, NOT from your current working directory. Read further there in a targeted way if needed.

Write 180 to 280 German words, only to {{ concept_output }}/{{ workflow_run_id }}/drafts/{{ concept }}.md.
Exactly these three headings, in this order:
## Wofür taugt das?
## Vorteile
## Nachteile und Kosten

Audience: technically interested readers without knowledge of the project who could adopt the mechanism. Explain the flow, one concrete sensible use, the benefit and the actual limits/costs. Sober, readable, no marketing. Claims must be backed by the fact packet or the code.
The page describes the mechanism, not an installation: do not state operating, inventory or usage figures of an instance and do not interpret any measurement. Name missing evidence (for instance for the practical benefit) explicitly as missing.
No H1 heading, no Mermaid or code blocks, no links, no meta comments: the script adds the diagram and the source links. No private names, paths, IDs, credentials or comparisons with external products.
Do not change any other files, no API/DB calls, no TODO changes, no git add/commit/push. The parent session takes care of tracking and review.
Use your write tool, then check that the file exists, and answer briefly with the file name.

set -euo pipefail
python3 {{ concept_root }}/scripts/concepts/pages.py assemble --root {{ concept_root }} --work {{ concept_output }}/{{ workflow_run_id }} --only {{ concept_only }}

set -euo pipefail
python3 {{ concept_root }}/scripts/concepts/pages.py check --root {{ concept_root }} --work {{ concept_output }}/{{ workflow_run_id }}/de --only {{ concept_only }}
